newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ Bank shares top record highs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ Bank shares top record highs.

text.p: Shares in Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd reached a record high of A$7.10 in early trade on Thursday as buyers, hungry for dividend yield, continued to increase their exposure to the banking sector.
Brokers said the big banks were continuing to find favour among both large and small investors.
"The banks are much sought after," said dealer Paul Ford of Shaw Stockbroking, saying the high yields held plenty of attraction for investors.
"The investors are still chasing yield and looking at the bonds, people are hoping for a further rate cut here," he said.
Among the other big banks, National Australia Bank Ltd also touched a record high, adding 21 cents to A$13.21.

Westpac Banking Corp gained 10 cents to A$6.47, only two cents shy of its A$6.49 record high reached in February, 1996. Commonwealth Bank shares were up eight cents at A$11.56 after touching a high of A$11.60.
Commonwealth Bank instalment receipts, hugely popular with investors since their introduction with the sale of the government's final stake in July, were 14 cents up at A$7.44.
